content:
maria: Customer report C-4711 — autorouter invoked add_tag instead of suspend_account. They sent a suspend request but the account wasn't suspended.

maria: Repro payload sent to our API:
```json
{"user_id":"U-1999","intent":"suspend_account","suspend":true,"reason":"fraud"}
```

maria: Router decision log shows `tool_choice: add_tag` with score 0.72 and arguments coerced to {"tag":"suspended"} :confused:

devon: Can you paste the wire-level router input/decision? :eyes:

maria: excerpt from dispatcher logs:
```
{"request_id":"r-8a7","payload_keys":["user_id","suspend","reason"],"decision":{"tool":"add_tag","score":0.72},"matched_signature":["user_id","suspend"]}
```

ashley: sounds like schema-shadowing / loose coercion — `suspend` boolean matched add_tag's optional `note`/`tag` param. :face_with_monocle: We should fail fast on incompatible types.

ashley: mitigation plan: 1) add strict type-check at dispatch to reject bool->string casts; 2) bump priority for explicit `suspend_account` alias mapping; 3) create an eval to catch this regression. I'll open a PR and +cc infra.

maria: customer is blocked. Can we do a temporary config override to prefer suspend_account for payloads containing `suspend` key? :pray:

devon: on it — applying stage config now, will promote to prod after smoke. Linking runbook: https://internal/runbooks/autorouter-schema-ambiguity

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-210 created (sev: low). Assigned: ashley. Ticket: https://issues/internal/INC-2026-210

maria: added repro steps to support case and asked customer for tolerance window. Will update when fix lands. :thumbsup:
